تشترطوا (form VIII)
# تَشْتَرِطُوا (taštariṭū) /taʃ.ta.ri.tˤuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِشْتَرَطَ (ištaraṭa)
# تُشْتَرَطُوا (tuštaraṭū) /tuʃ.ta.ra.tˤuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِشْتَرَطَ (ištaraṭa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
